scope: Fixed-design inference about associations encoded by the registered model revisions; never about employees, vacancies, regional labour markets, causality, population uncertainty, or true historical skill demand.

raw_cell_quantities.token_log_probability: For target token t_j, log_p_j = raw_target_logit_j - logsumexp(full_vocabulary_logits_j), computed in float32 or float64 after retaining the unmodified source-dtype target logit and normalization input metadata.
raw_cell_quantities.total_sequence_log_probability: L_total = sum(j=1..T) log_p_j. This is the preregistered primary scoring method and includes the model-token-length penalty.
raw_cell_quantities.mean_token_log_probability: L_mean = L_total / T. This is a secondary scoring-method sensitivity and is never called interchangeable with total sequence log probability.

normalization.operation: Separately for every model_revision x role_id x prompt_id x stratum_id x scoring_method, z-score the 28 analytical skill scores across the frozen primary vocabulary using the population standard deviation (ddof=0).
normalization.formula: z_mrpsk = (L_mrpsk - mean_k L_mrpsk) / sqrt(mean_k((L_mrpsk - mean_k L_mrpsk)^2))
normalization.zero_variance: Mark the entire normalization block missing with reason zero_skill_variance; do not set z to zero.
normalization.cross_model_rule: Never compare or pool unnormalized logits or log probabilities across model revisions.

primary_estimands.quantity: For each model x role x skill in global_unqualified, the arithmetic mean of total-score z values over the four fixed prompt IDs.
primary_estimands.completeness: all four matched prompt cells required

primary_estimands.quantity: For each model x skill, the arithmetic mean of role_skill_normalized_association_total over all seven frozen roles.
primary_estimands.weights: one seventh per role; no population, employment, vacancy, or regional weights

primary_estimands.quantity: Later-minus-earlier difference in the normalized association estimand for each role x skill and for each global skill summary, ordered only by publisher-documented pretraining cutoff.
primary_estimands.interpretation: checkpoint-association shift, not a causal time effect

secondary_estimands.quantity: Recompute every normalized association, rank, and adjacent-cutoff shift using L_mean in sensitivity/scoring_method/v1; never pool with L_total.
Descending midrank of the four-prompt normalized role-skill association among the 28 skills, with rank 1 highest; ties receive average ranks.
Descending midrank of the seven-role global skill association among the 28 skills, with rank 1 highest.
later rank minus earlier rank; negative values indicate a higher within-model rank in the later checkpoint.

For each role x skill and scoring method, mean(d_p)/sample_sd(d_p) across the four matched prompt-specific later-minus-earlier normalized differences; undefined when sample_sd is zero. The global version first averages each prompt-specific difference equally over seven roles, then applies the same formula across four prompt IDs.
Positive-control score minus negative-control score within each matched model x role x prompt x stratum and scoring method; diagnostic only.

prompt_rank_stability: all six pairwise Spearman rank correlations among four prompt-specific 28-skill ranks
all six pairwise Kendall tau-b correlations
pairwise Jaccard overlap of top five skills
stability.leave_one_prompt_out: Recompute normalized associations, ranks, and adjacent shifts after omitting each one of four prompt IDs; report minimum, maximum, sign concordance, and maximum absolute rank displacement.
stability.scoring_stability: Within each model x role, Spearman and Kendall tau-b between total-score and mean-token skill ranks; report top-five Jaccard overlap.
stability.geography_stability: In its own namespace, compare each region-label rank vector with global_unqualified and report region-pair rank correlations; do not interpret differences as regional outcomes.

fixed_prompt_resampling.label: fixed-design prompt sensitivity interval
fixed_prompt_resampling.method: percentile interval using deterministic PCG64 draws; report 2.5th and 97.5th empirical quantiles with the quantile algorithm recorded by the implementation
fixed_prompt_resampling.primary_unit: template ID is the only resampled unit. Draw four template IDs with replacement from {relevant_skill, work_association, relevant_capability, description_skill}; use the same draw jointly for every model, role, skill, and the adjacent contrast.
fixed_prompt_resampling.role_estimand: Reaverage the four drawn prompt-specific normalized values for the fixed role and skill.
fixed_prompt_resampling.global_estimand: For each drawn template ID, first average its normalized value equally across the seven fixed roles, then average the four draws. Roles are never resampled.
fixed_prompt_resampling.geography_estimand: Within a fixed region label, resample only the same four template IDs. Regions are never resampled or population-weighted.
fixed_prompt_resampling.prohibitions: These intervals are sensitivity summaries over four researcher-fixed wordings. They are not confidence intervals, population uncertainty, model-training uncertainty, employee uncertainty, vacancy uncertainty, or labour-market uncertainty.

tests_and_multiplicity.test: Two-sided exact sign-flip test of the mean later-minus-earlier normalized difference across the four matched template IDs (16 sign assignments); zero differences remain zero in every assignment.

families.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.05 across all 196 registered p-values

families.definition: 28 seven-role global skill shifts for total scoring
families.correction: Holm family-wise correction at alpha=0.05 across 28 registered p-values

families.definition: mean-token parallel role x skill shifts
families.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.05, kept separate from total scoring
Holm family-wise correction at alpha=0.05, kept separate from total scoring

tests_and_multiplicity.sensitivity_rule: Each additional namespace that computes p-values forms its own explicitly named family and correction; no p-values from controls, taxonomies, geographies, or panels are inserted into a primary family post hoc.
tests_and_multiplicity.reporting: Always report unadjusted p, adjusted p, family ID, effect direction, normalized shift, rank shift, fixed-design interval, and exact complete-cell count; no significance-only filtering.

missingness.cell_rule: Every expected cell has exactly one terminal status: complete or failed, with a typed failure-ledger entry. Never silently skip.
missingness.contrast_rule: A prompt-specific contrast requires both pinned model cells. A role estimand requires all four paired prompt units; a global estimand requires all seven complete role estimands. Otherwise mark it missing rather than use available cases.
missingness.normalization_rule: A normalization block requires all 28 primary skills. A missing skill makes the entire block missing so the reference set never changes.
missingness.summary: Report expected, complete, failed, paired-complete, and estimable counts by model, role, skill, prompt, stratum, scoring method, failure type, and namespace.

locked_exclusions: Control targets, aliases, and alternative-taxonomy targets are excluded from primary normalization and multiplicity families.
Instruction/chat, unknown-cutoff, different-scale, different-tokenizer, and different-architecture panels are excluded from the primary temporal series.
Geographic strata are excluded from global_unqualified primary estimates.
Release date is excluded as a temporal ordering variable.
Reserved O*NET validation material is excluded from all estimation, selection, normalization, testing, and multiplicity decisions.
